name: route_prescription_request
description: Route the patient's prescription refill request to the appropriate action. Always call this tool — never reply in plain text.

action.description: Who to contact: DOCTOR (call doctor's office), SKIP (no action needed)

confidence.description: How confident you are in the routing decision based on the patient's message

confirmation_sms.description: Friendly 1–2 sentence SMS to send the patient confirming what action is being taken. If SKIP, explain you're skipping. If calling, say who you're calling.

doctor_call_notes.description: Brief context for the doctor call (e.g. 'Patient says prescription expired' or 'Doctor hasn't sent new script yet'). Include only when action is DOCTOR.

outcome_sms_template.description: Template for the outcome SMS to send after the call completes. Use {{CALL_RESULT}} as a placeholder for the actual call outcome. E.g. 'Done! {{CALL_RESULT}} They usually process these within 1–2 business days.'
